name: memolens
description: Find meaningful moments in a private photo and video library, then shape them into an unsaved, provenance-grounded Timeline 1.0 draft—locally and read-only.

interface.shortDescription: Find private moments. Shape an unsaved story.
interface.longDescription: MemoLens gives Codex a calm, local-first path from memory to edit: find private photos and current video moments, inspect source-backed details, and arrange selections into an unsaved hard-cut Timeline 1.0 draft. Safe-default access is read-only SQLite, and no third-party model API key is required. The plugin cannot save, render, export, delete, or write to arbitrary paths.
defaultPrompt: Find the strongest photo and video moments for a one-minute story about my recent trip.
Turn these MemoLens moments into an unsaved hard-cut timeline draft for review.
Show what MemoLens can read locally, then explain its privacy and write boundaries.
